Gadi Eisenkot Tapped to Form Israeli Government, Targets Netanyahu's Policies

Gadi Eisenkot has been invited by the Israeli president to form a majority government after Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu failed to form a coalition. Upon unveiling his agenda, Eisenkot immediately targeted Netanyahu's policies and legacy, with the new Israeli parliament sworn in. Eisenkot has proposed an October 7 commission.
